<thought>Based on the SNAr retrosynthetic template identified for the target molecule, the reaction disconnects the C–N bond between the aromatic ring and the piperazine nitrogen. This yields two fragments: the aryl halide (with a chlorine substituent) and the Boc‑protected piperazine amine. The corresponding SMILES for these precursors are:
- Aryl chloride: Clc2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3
- Protected amine: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1

These two SMILES together form the complete set of precursors.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"Clc2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3\", \"CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1\"]]</final_answer>
